why: Read the pieces in a fixed order: up arrow, down arrow, ball on top, ball at bottom, then repeat. Option 4 also has 5 pieces, but its order is wrong (up, down, up...).
trick: When lines grow by a fixed number, first count the pieces, then check the order of each piece.
